chain: Trivy distribution/action integrity lost standing during the documented compromise window.
The Trivy payload was capable of stealing CI-accessible credentials.
LiteLLM later stated that its compromise came from the Trivy security-scan dependency.
LiteLLM stated that a maintainer PyPI account was hijacked and malicious versions 1.82.7 and 1.82.8 were uploaded directly to PyPI outside normal GitHub CI/CD.
forbidden_use: Do not inject this chain into reconstructed pre-trigger manifests.
